lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Mother Serene sent us. A man reached Eldenmere.

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: He made it?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: She’s looking after him. Where do you need us?

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: Here, first. We brought these two clear of the cave.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Let me see that dressing. Keep your arm still for a moment.

lines.speaker: arrival_worker
lines.text: All right. Thank you.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: Who haven’t you found?

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: One of the workers. The creature pulled him back into the cave.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: Did anyone hear him afterward?

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: He answered when we called. I heard him again before you came through the arch.

lines.speaker: regent_clerk
lines.text: I have the crew list. Show me who is here.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: Bring it here. We’ll account for everyone.

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: Your men said the ground had already been placed under the Crown.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: They were acting on my orders.

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: Mother Serene gave no agreement.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: No. She did not.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: There’ll be no more work here. Tell me what you need for the injured.

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: Clean water, cloths, and room to work. Keep the path to the hall clear.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: We’ll keep it clear.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: That will hold. Keep the arm supported; I’ll leave the cloths here.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Is the footing at the entrance loose?

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: There’s fallen stone. We couldn’t reach the man safely.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: Show me exactly where you heard him.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Then I’m going with you.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: You two stay here.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: We came to help bring them back.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: If he’s trapped under something, you’ll need more than a sword. I have the tools.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: Then you stay behind me until we know what’s ahead.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: Go with them, Lucan. Bring our people back. I’ll remain here.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: Stay with the caretakers, my lord.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: I will. Page, help me with the names.

lines.speaker: regent_clerk
lines.text: Yes, your lordship.

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: Nessa keeps the visitor room ready. Through the hall, then the north door with the bed plaque.

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: If you need to recover, come back. We’ll keep it available.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: We find him first. Keep close, and call out anything you see.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Watch the loose stone.

lines.speaker: arrival_caretaker
lines.text: I’ll lift the rail. Call back if you need us.
